items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: They had Eugene Gilbo(?), a fine pianist and arranger that worked with the Treniers for years and years.

ctx.x: California now. And he really had a beautiful sound on the tenor saxophone. Who else was in the band...? They had Eugene Gilbo(?), a fine pianist and arranger that worked with the Treniers for years and years.
